label: adult-s2
resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. Every hidden ReLU takes inputs from one feature group (no splits). Most hidden nodes do nothing nonlinear on train (two always off, six always on, two indicators); only the capital-gain hinge matters: all-affine fit AUC 0.9008 vs 0.9064 full. z-scoring side effects: rare one-hots give large swings (native-country:28, n=20, +17 logit); native-country:15 constant on train acts as bias.
tool_bugs: Annotate validator accepted compositions with empty subgraph_connections (coverage then 0.907; undone and redone with child-exit->identity edges). compute_shap (500) ~28 min at ~440% CPU.
summary: Generalised additive logistic model of P(income<=50K): logit = 2.407 + capital + household + education + work + background, no cross-group interactions. Convex piecewise-linear capital-gain penalty (kink ~$4-4.7k); married-civ-spouse -3.52 partly offset by a Husband ReLU (+0.74); education years as a hinge steepening from HS-grad up. Train acc 0.850, AUC 0.906.
